narrative.intro: This ranking shows federal contract obligations by NAICS code for FY2026 to date. Total obligations stand at $390B. The largest NAICS markets are led by Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $40.3B, followed by Aircraft Manufacturing at $33.4B, and Engineering Services at $31.7B. Other major categories include Facilities Support Services at $30.8B, Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $27.7B, and Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers at $27.2B. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing records $25.3B, Computer Systems Design Services has $19.7B, Ship Building and Repairing shows $16.1B, and Other Computer Related Services accounts for $14.1B. These ten NAICS codes represent the top federal contracting markets for the fiscal year to date. The list mixes construction, manufacturing, services, research, and health sectors, showing where federal obligations are concentrated across industry types during FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: Which NAICS sectors lead federal contract obligations?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction leads with $40.3B in obligations. Aircraft Manufacturing and Engineering Services follow with $33.4B and $31.7B respectively. Facilities Support Services and R&D in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences also rank among the top, with $30.8B and $27.7B.

sections.heading: What mix of industry types appears in the top NAICS list?
sections.body: The top ten include construction, manufacturing, professional services, research, and health insurance. That mix shows federal buying across physical assets, technical systems, and services, with examples like Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing at $25.3B and Computer Systems Design Services at $19.7B. Ship Building and Repairing and Other Computer Related Services appear with $16.1B and $14.1B.

faq.q: What are the biggest federal contracting industries?
faq.a: The biggest federal contracting industries by obligations for FY2026 to date are led by Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $40.3B, Aircraft Manufacturing at $33.4B, and Engineering Services at $31.7B. Other top industries are Facilities Support Services at $30.8B; Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $27.7B; Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers at $27.2B; Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing at $25.3B; Computer Systems Design Services at $19.7B; Ship Building and Repairing at $16.1B; and Other Computer Related Services at $14.1B. Total obligations across NAICS for FY2026 to date are $390B.
